values./system/description:
The minigun is a motorized Gatling-style rapid fire weapon commonly employed by the military, or other lesser factions that managed to acquire such a weapon. Miniguns can be found as mounted door guns on Vertibirds or as a handheld heavy assault and support weapon. The high rate-of-fire of the weapon means that it can produce devastating results, but at a cost of consuming ammo at incredible rates, making it difficult to keep the weapon supplied.

A Minigun can accept one each of the following mods, which are unique to the minigun and installed with the Repair skill:

  • Barrel: Accelerated Barrel, Tri-Barrel
  • Sights: Gunner Sight
  • Muzzle: Shredder
